data.name: UiTokenStepApplication
data.value: 1. Sign in to Discord Developer Portal. Select your app under Applications, or click New Application to create one.

data.name: UiTokenStepReset
data.value: 2. Open Bot and click Reset Token. Confirm the reset and enter your two-factor code if Discord asks. Copy the token when it appears. Resetting replaces the previous token.

data.name: UiTokenStepIntent
data.value: 3. On the Bot page, enable Message Content Intent under Privileged Gateway Intents and save the change.

data.name: UiTokenStepInstall
data.value: 4. If the bot is new to the server, open Installation, enable Guild Install and select Discord Provided Link. Add the bot scope and grant View Channels and Read Message History for the channels you want to archive. Open the install link and add the bot to your server.

data.name: UiTokenStepConnect
data.value: 5. Paste the token into this app and click the plug icon. To resume a paused copy, click Resume after entering the token.

data.name: UiOAuthRedirectSteps
data.value: 1. Choose the address visitors will use. For local viewing use http://127.0.0.1:8080/auth/callback. For a public viewer use its HTTPS address followed by /auth/callback, for example https://archive.example.org/auth/callback. 2. Open the Discord Developer Portal and select an application, or choose New Application. In OAuth2, copy Client ID and Client Secret. Generate a secret there if needed. 3. In OAuth2 → Redirects choose Add Redirect, paste the full URI from step 1 and save changes. Paste the exact same URI below, including the scheme, host, port if used, and /auth/callback. 4. Save these settings, start the viewer at that address and select Sign in with Discord.
